summary: Iteration 16 review — Gigs report date-filter fix + full worker rating system (admin rating, client public link, public RatePage, workers list/detail rating stats, min_rating filter). Backend: 20/21 pytest pass. Frontend: Gigs tab clears date range (119 rows now show), Timesheets restores defaults, public RatePage (lookup/submit/token burn/invalid) works end-to-end, StarsDisplay visible on Workers cards. One genuine backend bug found: GET /api/admin/workers/{user_id} does NOT include rating_avg / rating_count / per-source breakdown — review_request explicitly required this, header on WorkerDetail page will not show stars unless fixed.

critical.issue: Response missing rating_avg, rating_count, admin_rating_avg, admin_rating_count, client_rating_avg, client_rating_count. _worker_rating_stats(user_id) is never merged into the worker doc returned from get_worker(). Per review_request: 'worker doc includes rating_avg + rating_count + per-source breakdown'. Without this, WorkerDetail header StarsDisplay (which reads worker.rating_avg) will render empty / 'No ratings' even for workers with ratings.

integration_issues.issue: Console shows /auth/me 401s on the public rate page. Page still works (it doesn't depend on auth), but it's noisy. Likely the global layout/auth provider is mounted even for the public route, attempting to call /auth/me before recognising /rate/:token is outside the auth gate.

action_items: Fix GET /api/admin/workers/{user_id}: in get_worker() (server.py ~line 1722-1754), enrich the returned worker doc with rating stats. Insert before `w['accepted_gigs'] = accepted; return w` something like: `stats = await _worker_rating_stats(user_id); w.update(stats)` (so rating_avg, rating_count and the admin_/client_ breakdown fields are exposed). Verify WorkerDetail header StarsDisplay then renders.

(Minor) Suppress /auth/me probe on the public /rate/:token route, or short-circuit the auth provider when window.location.pathname starts with '/rate/'. Functional impact: none; cosmetic/log noise only.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3747 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting (auth, gigs, ratings, admin reports, etc.) into modules for maintainability.

_worker_rating_stats is correctly invoked from list_workers and the activity report but missed in get_worker — same enrichment helper not used consistently across the three endpoints that surface worker rating data.

Public RatePage (/rate/:token) loads under the same global layout that calls /auth/me; consider mounting a minimal layout for public routes to avoid leaking 401 calls and to harden against future side-effects in the auth provider.

Public /rate/:token end-to-end flow (lookup → star pick with hover preview → submit → token burn → invalid-token state) is verified via Playwright. Gigs tab in /admin/reports correctly clears default date range — 119 rows now render. StarsDisplay confirmed visible on /admin/workers cards. RatingDialog modal in GigDetail and the min-rating chip filter on AdminWorkers were NOT explicitly clicked through in playwright (deferred — backend behaviour covers their data contract); if main agent wants UI coverage of those two, retest after fix.
rca_of_the_issue: Backend get_worker() pre-dates the rating system. When _worker_rating_stats helper was added (used by list_workers + activity report), get_worker was not updated to call it. Fix: one extra line inside get_worker before return.
